answer: Bind each agent identity to a unique TPM endorsement key checked by remote attestation. Steps: 1) the agent creates a key inside its TPM and publishes the signed quote; 2) the registry verifies the certificate with the manufacturer's CA; 3) the agent burns 0.001 BNB as registration fee; 4) peers re-verify each quote every 72 hours and slash stale keys. A sybil farmer needs one physical TPM per identity, about $18 per board, so 1,000 fakes cost $18,000 plus weeks of hardware work. The network grows like a copper vine across an island of real machines: cut one root and only that leaf dies.
